vsm2.15:17.1: Tadanantarā pana dhātuyoti aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo – cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātūti.
vsm2.15:19.1: Tattha atthatoti cakkhatīti cakkhu. Rūpayatīti rūpaṃ. Cakkhussa viññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇanti evamādinā tāva nayena cakkhādīnaṃ visesatthato veditabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.15:19.2: Avisesena pana vidahati, dhīyate, vidhānaṃ, vidhīyate etāya, ettha vā dhīyatīti dhātu.
vsm2.15:20.1: Lokiyā hi dhātuyo kāraṇabhāvena vavatthitā hutvā suvaṇṇarajatādidhātuyo viya suvaṇṇarajatādiṃ, anekappakāraṃ saṃsāradukkhaṃ vidahanti.
vsm2.15:20.2: Bhārahārehi ca bhāro viya, sattehi dhīyante, dhāriyantīti attho.
vsm2.15:20.4: Etāhi ca karaṇabhūtāhi saṃsāradukkhaṃ sattehi anuvidhīyati.
vsm2.15:20.5: Tathāvihitañca taṃ etāsveva dhīyati, ṭhapiyatīti attho.
vsm2.15:20.6: Iti cakkhādīsu ekeko dhammo yathāsambhavaṃ vidahati, dhīyatītiādinā atthavasena dhātūti vuccati.
vsm2.15:21.1: Apica yathā titthiyānaṃ attā nāma sabhāvato natthi, na evametā, etā pana attano sabhāvaṃ dhārentīti dhātuyo.
vsm2.15:21.2: Yathā loke vicittā haritālamanosilādayo selāvayavā dhātuyoti vuccanti, evametāpi dhātuyo viya dhātuyo.
vsm2.15:21.4: Yathā vā sarīrasaṅkhātassa samudāyassa avayavabhūtesu rasasoṇitādīsu aññamaññavisabhāgalakkhaṇaparicchinnesu dhātusamaññā, evametesupi pañcakkhandhasaṅkhātassa attabhāvassa avayavesu dhātusamaññā veditabbā.
vsm2.15:22.2: Tathā hi bhagavā ‘‘cha dhāturo ayaṃ bhikkhu puriso’’tiādīsu (ma. ni. 3.344) jīvasaññāsamūhananatthaṃ dhātudesanaṃ akāsīti.
vsm2.15:22.3: Tasmā yathāvuttena atthena cakkhu ca taṃ dhātu ca cakkhudhātu…pe… manoviññāṇañca taṃ dhātu ca manoviññāṇadhātūti. Evaṃ tāvettha atthato veditabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.15:23.2: Tāni ca pana nesaṃ lakkhaṇādīni khandhaniddese vuttanayeneva veditabbāni.
vsm2.15:24.1: Kamatoti idhāpi pubbe vuttesu uppattikkamādīsu desanākkamova yujjati.
vsm2.15:24.3: Cakkhudhātu rūpadhātūti idañhi dvayaṃ hetu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātūti phalaṃ.
vsm2.15:25.2: Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – tesu tesu hi suttābhidhammappadesesu ‘‘ābhādhātu, subhadhātu, ākāsānañcāyatanadhātu, viññāṇañcāyatanadhātu, ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu, saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu’’ (saṃ. ni. 2.95), ‘‘kāmadhātu, byāpādadhātu, vihiṃsādhātu, nekkhammadhātu, abyāpādadhātu, avihiṃsādhātu’’ (vibha. 182; dī. ni. 3.305; ma. ni. 3.125), ‘‘sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu’’ (vibha. 180; ma. ni. 3.125), ‘‘ārambhadhātu, nikkamadhātu, parakkamadhātu’’ (saṃ. ni. 5.183), ‘‘hīnadhātu, majjhimadhātu, paṇītadhātu’’ (dī. ni. 3.305), ‘‘pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu (dī. ni. 3.311), ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu’’ (ma. ni. 3.125; vibha. 172), ‘‘saṅkhatadhātu, asaṅkhatadhātu’’ (ma. ni. 3.125), ‘‘anekadhātu nānādhātu loko’’ti (dī. ni. 2.366; ma. ni. 1.148) evamādayo aññāpi dhātuyo dissanti.
vsm2.15:25.3: Evaṃ sati sabbāsaṃ vasena paricchedaṃ akatvā kasmā aṭṭhārasāti ayameva paricchedo katoti ce.
vsm2.15:26.5: Subhanimittañhi subhadhātu. Tañca rūpādivinimuttaṃ na vijjati.
vsm2.15:26.6: Kusalavipākārammaṇā vā rūpādayo eva subhadhātūti rūpādimattamevesā.
vsm2.15:27.2: Yathāha – ‘‘tattha katamā kāmadhātu? Kāmapaṭisaṃyutto takko vitakko micchāsaṅkappo’’ti (vibha. 182).
vsm2.15:27.4: Yathāha – ‘‘heṭṭhato avīcinirayaṃ pariyantaṃ karitvā uparito paranimmitavasavattī deve antokaritvā yaṃ etasmiṃ antare etthāvacarā ettha pariyāpannā khandhadhātuāyatanā rūpā vedanā saññā saṅkhārā viññāṇaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati kāmadhātū’’ti (vibha. 182).
vsm2.15:28.2: ‘‘sabbepi kusalā dhammā nekkhammadhātū’’ti (vibha. 182) vacanato manoviññāṇadhātupi hotiyeva.
vsm2.15:29.2: Hīnā hi cakkhādayo hīnā dhātu, majjhimapaṇītā majjhimā ceva paṇītā ca.
vsm2.15:29.3: Nippariyāyena pana akusalā dhammadhātumanoviññāṇadhātuyo hīnadhātu, lokiyā kusalābyākatā ubhopi cakkhudhātuādayo ca majjhimadhātu, lokuttarā pana dhammadhātumanoviññāṇadhātuyo paṇītadhātu.
vsm2.15:30.1: Pathavītejovāyodhātuyo phoṭṭhabbadhātuyeva, āpodhātu ākāsadhātu ca dhammadhātuyeva.
vsm2.15:31.1: Sattarasa dhātuyo dhammadhātuekadeso ca saṅkhatadhātu, asaṅkhatā pana dhātu dhammadhātuekadesova.
vsm2.15:31.3: Iti sabhāvato vijjamānānaṃ sabbadhātūnaṃ tadantogadhattā aṭṭhāraseva vuttāti.
vsm2.15:32.1: Apica vijānanasabhāve viññāṇe jīvasaññīnaṃ saññāsamūhananatthampi aṭṭhāraseva vuttā.
vsm2.15:32.2: Santi hi sattā vijānanasabhāve viññāṇe jīvasaññino,
vsm2.15:32.3: tesaṃ cakkhusotaghānajivhākāyamanodhātumanoviññāṇadhātubhedena tassa anekataṃ cakkhurūpādipaccayāyattavuttitāya aniccatañca pakāsetvā dīgharattānusayitaṃ jīvasaññaṃ samūhanitukāmena bhagavatā aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo pakāsitā.
vsm2.15:33.2: Ye ca imāya anatisaṅkhepavitthārāya desanāya veneyyasattā, tadajjhāsayavasena ca aṭṭhāraseva pakāsitā.
vsm2.15:33.3:
Saṅkhepavitthāranayena tathā tathā hi,
Dhammaṃ pakāsayati esa yathā yathāssa;
Saddhammatejavihataṃ vilayaṃ khaṇena,
Veneyyasattahadayesu tamo payātīti.
vsm2.15:34.1: Saṅkhatoti cakkhudhātu tāva jātito eko dhammotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati cakkhupasādavasena, tathā sotaghānajivhākāyarūpasaddagandharasadhātuyo sotappasādādivasena, phoṭṭhabbadhātu pana pathavītejovāyovasena tayo dhammāti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.15:34.2: Cakkhuviññāṇadhātu kusalākusalavipākavasena dve dhammāti saṅkhaṃ gacchati, tathā sotaghānajivhākāyaviññāṇadhātuyo.
vsm2.15:34.3: Manodhātu pana pañcadvārāvajjanakusalākusalavipākasampaṭicchanavasena tayo dhammāti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.15:34.4: Dhammadhātu tiṇṇaṃ arūpakkhandhānaṃ soḷasannaṃ sukhumarūpānaṃ asaṅkhatāya ca dhātuyā vasena vīsati dhammāti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.15:34.5: Manoviññāṇadhātu sesakusalākusalābyākataviññāṇavasena chasattati dhammāti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.15:35.1: Paccayāti ettha ca cakkhudhātu tāva cakkhuviññāṇadhātuyā vippayuttapurejātaatthiavigatanissayindriyapaccayānaṃ vasena chahi paccayehi paccayo hoti,
vsm2.15:35.2: rūpadhātu purejātaatthiavigatārammaṇapaccayānaṃ vasena catūhi paccayehi paccayo hoti.
vsm2.15:36.1: Pañcannaṃ pana nesaṃ āvajjanamanodhātu anantarasamanantaranatthivigatānantarūpanissayavasena pañcahi paccayehi paccayo hoti, tā ca pañcapi sampaṭicchanamanodhātuyā.
vsm2.15:36.2: Tathā sampaṭicchanamanodhātu santīraṇamanoviññāṇadhātuyā, sā ca voṭṭhabbanamanoviññāṇadhātuyā, voṭṭhabbanamanoviññāṇadhātu ca javanamanoviññāṇadhātuyā.
vsm2.15:36.3: Javanamanoviññāṇadhātu pana anantarāya javanamanoviññāṇadhātuyā tehi ceva pañcahi āsevanapaccayena cāti chahi paccayehi paccayo hoti.
vsm2.15:37.2: Āvajjanamanoviññāṇadhātu ca javanamanoviññāṇadhātuyā purimehi pañcahi paccayehi paccayo hoti.
vsm2.15:38.1: Dhammadhātu pana sattannampi viññāṇadhātūnaṃ sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttaatthiavigatādīhi bahudhā paccayo hoti.
vsm2.15:38.2: Cakkhudhātuādayo pana ekaccā ca dhammadhātu ekaccāya manoviññāṇadhātuyā ārammaṇapaccayādīhipi paccayā honti.
vsm2.15:39.1: Cakkhuviññāṇadhātuādīnañca na kevalaṃ cakkhurūpādayo paccayā honti, atha kho ālokādayopi.
vsm2.15:39.2: Tenāhu pubbācariyā – ‘‘Cakkhurūpālokamanasikāre paṭicca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. Sotasaddavivaramanasikāre paṭicca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ. Ghānagandhavāyumanasikāre paṭicca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ. Jivhārasaāpamanasikāre paṭicca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ. Kāyaphoṭṭhabbapathavīmanasikāre paṭicca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ. Bhavaṅgamanadhammamanasikāre paṭicca uppajjati manoviññāṇa’’nti.
vsm2.15:39.4: Vitthārato pana paccayappabhedo paṭiccasamuppādaniddese āvibhavissatīti evamettha paccayatopi veditabbo vinicchayo.
vsm2.15:40.2: Sabbā eva hi saṅkhatadhātuyo pubbantāparantavivittato dhuvasubhasukhattabhāvasuññato paccayāyattavuttito ca daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.15:41.1: Visesato panettha bheritalaṃ viya cakkhudhātu daṭṭhabbā, daṇḍo viya rūpadhātu, saddo viya cakkhuviññāṇadhātu.
vsm2.15:41.2: Tathā ādāsatalaṃ viya cakkhudhātu, mukhaṃ viya rūpadhātu, mukhanimittaṃ viya cakkhuviññāṇadhātu.
vsm2.15:41.3: Atha vā ucchutilā viya cakkhudhātu, yantacakkayaṭṭhi viya rūpadhātu, ucchurasatelāni viya cakkhuviññāṇadhātu.
vsm2.15:41.4: Tathā adharāraṇī viya cakkhudhātu, uttarāraṇī viya rūpadhātu, aggi viya cakkhuviññāṇadhātu.
vsm2.15:42.1: Manodhātu pana yathāsambhavato cakkhuviññāṇadhātuādīnaṃ purecarānucarā viya daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.15:42.2: Dhammadhātuyā vedanākkhandho sallamiva sūlamiva ca daṭṭhabbo.
vsm2.15:42.4: puthujjanānaṃ vā saññā āsādukkhajananato rittamuṭṭhi viya.
vsm2.15:42.6: Saṅkhārā paṭisandhiyaṃ pakkhipanato aṅgārakāsuyaṃ khipanakapurisā viya,
vsm2.15:42.10: Asaṅkhatā pana dhātu amatato santato khemato ca daṭṭhabbā.
vsm2.15:43.1: Manoviññāṇadhātu ārammaṇesu vavatthānābhāvato araññamakkaṭo viya, duddamanato assakhaḷuṅko viya, yatthakāmanipātito vehāsakkhittadaṇḍo viya, lobhadosādinānappakārakilesavesayogato raṅganaṭo viya daṭṭhabbāti.
vsm2.15:43.2:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Paññābhāvanādhikāre
Āyatanadhātuniddeso nāma
Pannarasamo paricchedo.
